verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs say it manages ISO 27001 alongside SOC 2 and other frameworks in one platform, with pre-mapped controls, audit-partner selection, and audit-ready reports. That establishes ISO 27001 as a supported framework, but nothing shows how deep that support goes. Missing for 10: any evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts or workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of ISO 27001 depth (the only detailed launchpad guide shown is for SOC 2).
